scope: 19 Chapter 2 reading and illustration foley cues; no minigame/Live-final edits
processing: Cropped, filtered and layered existing recordings; selected long cues have localized offline transient gain edits, followed by static loudness gain. Short cues use static RMS gain.
verification: FFmpeg integrated loudness/true peak, RMS/sample peak and clipping measurements. Not an auditory review or Play Mode test.
sourcePolicy: No downloads. Per-layer source URL, attribution, license evidence and SHA-256 retained.
